_note: Facts of the block “Мова стенду / Stand Talk” (design §6.5: one number in one place). Used in lesson texts as {{fact:stand-talk.<id>}}; each text is a fragment that fits into a sentence in each language. Rule numbers are checked against docs/rules/data (FITASC editions of 01/01/2025); unit conversions against NIST SP 811, Appendix B.8. Rule numbers are not repeated here: since 2026-10-07 the Stand Talk lessons use the shared facts rules.release-within-3s, rules.sonopull-delay, rules.sporting-time-between-targets, rules.compak-time-to-call, rules.squad-max-shooters, rules.sporting-jacket-line, rules.reshow-after-interruption, gear.fitasc-max-gauge, gear.fitasc-min-barrel, gear.fitasc-shot-load and gear.fitasc-shot-diameter (one id per number).

sporting-reshow-limit.note: Rule ch16-presentation: on request, no more than two targets are shown again for each target of the menu, so each target of the menu can be repeated up to two times.

unit-foot.note: 1 ft = 0.3048 m exactly (NIST SP 811, Appendix B.8).

unit-yard.note: 1 yd = 0.9144 m exactly (NIST SP 811, Appendix B.8).
